name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Descriptor accurately reflects the body: a slide-out (slide-down) animation that closes the status/dialog panel, restores the saved VGA snapshot, frees the three slide workspaces, and recomposites the scene. It is the symmetric counterpart of fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in. No Ghidra address residue in the name (no hex suffix matching its own/data address).
purpose: Close the status/dialog panel (counterpart of fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in): play a 5-frame slide-out, restore the underlying screen, free the slide workspaces, and recomposite the battle/field scene.
logic_summary: 5-frame slide-down loop (frame_iter 1..5) calling fd2_slide_panel_down_step(frame_iter*0xD + 0x70, accumulator, target) to slide the panel rows out to mode-13h VRAM; then memmove(0xA0000, bg_snapshot, 64000) restores the underlying screen; then free the three 64000-byte workspaces (accumulator/a, bg_snapshot/b, target/c); finally fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) recomposites the battle/field scene. EBX is the loop counter (callee-saved PUSH/POP); compiler-injected __CHK(0x14) stack-probe prologue.
notes: Decompile and disassembly (34 instr, 4 blocks) match the src body and src comment exactly: IMUL EAX,EBX,0xD / ADD EAX,0x70 (frame*0xD+0x70), workspaces 0x53C5B (a/accumulator), 0x53C5F (b/bg_snapshot), 0x53C63 (c/target), memmove 0xFA00=64000 to 0xA0000 from b, three free calls a/b/c, fd2_composite_battle_frame(0), POP EBX/RET. Src comment is precise and correct -> keep. Ghidra plate (Chinese) describes the same pipeline with correct constants and is consistent with the refined understanding (it frames the opener as fd2_load_chapter_portrait and counts 25 call sites; the src frames the opener as the symmetric fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in and counts 10 distinct caller functions -- both valid, non-contradictory framings), so plate left untouched. Caller-count framing: 10 distinct caller functions / 25 call sites (get_xrefs_to). Name keep, void params.
